dataset.name: Primary adrenocortical carcinoma QuantSeq cohort (2022)
dataset.description: Independent French and German primary adrenocortical-carcinoma cohort with FFPE QuantSeq 3' bulk RNA-seq and individual OS and DFS follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Operated primary adrenocortical carcinomas from Cochin Hospital and University Hospital Wuerzburg. Adenomas, tumors of uncertain malignant potential and duplicate intratumor regions are excluded before analysis.
dataset.publication_citation: Jouinot et al. European Journal of Endocrinology 2022

metadata.source_program: Cochin Hospital and University Hospital Wuerzburg
metadata.library_method: Lexogen QuantSeq 3' mRNA-Seq from FFPE tissue
metadata.curation_note: Eligibility is fixed before outcome analysis: Diagnosis must equal ACC and Cohort must be training or validation. Rows labeled intratumor_heterogeneity are secondary regions and are excluded, leaving one primary-tumor profile per patient.

expression.label: log2(QuantSeq counts + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Published Supplementary Table S2 Transcript_ID field
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols duplicated after case normalization are excluded rather than combined implicitly.
expression.scale_note: Published HTSeq count values are non-negative. TCGA-TRACE applies log2(count + 1) once; it does not reproduce the paper's DESeq2 normalization for cross-sample differential-expression testing.
